table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	item.ICode,
	item.CustomICode,
	item.Name,
	manufacturer=manufacturer.Name,
	item.ICCode,
	itemclass.name,
	item.ICatCode,
	ItemCategory=itemcategory.name,
	PackingDesc=Item.PackingDesc,
	item.Packcode,
	itempacking.name,
	item.SalePrice,
	item.PurPrice,
	item.RetailPrice,
	item.AvgPrice,
	item.SaleDiscPerc,
	item.PurDiscPerc,
	item.SalesTax,
	item.ReorderQty,
	item.OptimumQty,
	item.PackUnits,
	item.Active,
	item.Prescribed,
	item.Refrigrated,
	item.Printable,
	item.Location1,
	item.Remarks1,
	item.Location,
	item.Remarks,
	item.Gcode,
	godown.name,
	item.reorderLevel,
	item.OptimumLevel,
	item.RecentPurPrice,
	item.SalePrice2,
	item.SalePrice3,
	item.GReorderQty,
	item.GOptimumQty,
	Taxable=Item.Taxable,
	Item.Packsalestax,
	Item.RegdNo,
	ItemAlert = (SELECT IA.Name FROM ItemAlert IA WHERE IA.ItemAlertCode=Item.ItemAlertCode),
	Supplier = (SELECT MAX(A.Name)
		FROM Accounts A, Supplier S, ItemSuppliers ITS
		WHERE ITS.ICode=Item.ICode AND ITS.SuppCode = S.SuppCode AND S.SuppCode=A.AccCode AND
			ITS.Priority IN
			(SELECT Priority=MIN(ITTS.Priority) FROM ItemSuppliers ITTS WHERE ICode=Item.ICode))
FROM 
	Item 
	LEFT OUTER JOIN ItemPacking ON (Item.PackCode = ItemPacking.Packcode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN itemclass ON (Item.ICCode = itemclass.ICCode),
	itemcategory,
	godown,
	manufacturer
WHERE 
	item.gcode=godown.gcode AND
	(item.icatcode=itemcategory.icatcode)AND
	(item.manfcode in (:aa_manfcode) ) and
	item.manfcode=manufacturer.manfcode
